assertions.title: Empty state when no scored contacts exist

steps.observed: Brief page loaded with company header showing Vercel, Cloud Computing, 201-500 employees

steps.expected: Empty state message prompting to run scoring first
steps.observed: Outreach section displays: 'No scored contacts yet. Run lead scoring first to see recommended contacts for outreach.'
No Generate Message buttons visible in the Outreach section

evidence.network: Page load only, no mutation requests

steps.expected: Brief page loads for Stripe with all sections
steps.observed: Brief page loaded with Research, Contacts, Lead Scoring, and Outreach sections

steps.expected: Top 1-3 contacts shown with name, title, score context, and Generate Message action
steps.observed: Outreach section shows 'Outreach 3' header with 3 contact cards
Eileen O'Mara - CRO · Executive - Grade A - 93/100 - Generate Message button
Rayane Radjabaly - Head of Sales, Commercial (Mid-market), EMEA · Sales - Grade A - 92/100 - Generate Message button
Ola Carlman - Head of Nordics and Israel · Sales - Grade A - 92/100 - Generate Message button

steps.expected: Contacts sorted by total score descending

steps.action: Click Generate Message on Eileen O'Mara card
steps.expected: Message generation starts, text streams incrementally
steps.observed: Clicked Generate Message button; text began appearing incrementally in the card
Screenshot at 2s shows partial message with multiple paragraphs already rendered — text was streaming in

steps.expected: Full message visible, loading indicator removed
steps.observed: Full personalized cold email visible with greeting, body paragraphs, and sign-off. Generate Message button replaced with Regenerate button. No loading indicator.

assertions.title: Message generation error is contact-scoped

steps.action: Verify other contact cards after successful generation for Eileen O'Mara
steps.expected: Other cards unaffected, still showing Generate Message buttons
steps.observed: Rayane Radjabaly and Ola Carlman cards still show Generate Message buttons, unaffected by Eileen O'Mara's generation

steps.expected: Research, Contacts, Lead Scoring sections intact
steps.observed: Full page screenshot confirms Research (with report content), Contacts (5 contacts listed), and Lead Scoring (5 scored contacts) all remain in success state with Rerun buttons

evidence.network: No unexpected requests to other section APIs

assertions.issues: Could not trigger a natural error for message generation. Verified the alternative criteria: after one contact's message generates successfully, other contact cards and all other sections remain unaffected.

steps.action: Verify Regenerate button is present after initial generation
steps.expected: Regenerate button visible on Eileen O'Mara card
steps.observed: Regenerate button visible below the generated message
Message mentions 'pushing the boundaries of how payments can fuel enterprise growth' and signs off as 'Outbound Specialist, ProspectKit'
New message generated with different content: mentions 'highlighted the need for scalable outbound strategies' and signs off as 'SDR at ProspectKit'. Old message completely replaced.

steps.expected: Regenerate button present for further regenerations
steps.observed: Regenerate button still visible after regeneration

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 5 passed, 0 failed. All outreach section behaviors work correctly — empty state shows proper prompt, top 3 contacts displayed sorted by score, message generation streams incrementally, generation is contact-scoped, and regenerate replaces previous message.
